# RedCity Dental Care & Implant Centre

> A dental clinic at 47 A/1, South Model Gram, Ludhiana, Punjab 141002, India (near South Model Town). Led by Dr. Arvind Sahu, BDS, MDS (Prosthodontics & Crown and Bridge), Registration No. 20407A.

- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 76268 58230
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 10 am to 8 pm; Sunday 10 am to 2 pm
- Map pin: 30.8910931, 75.833524 (Google Business Profile listing "Red City Dental Care and Implant Centre")
- Languages: English, Punjabi (ਪੰਜਾਬੀ), Hindi (हिंदी)
- Website: https://www.redcitydental.com

## Dr. Arvind Sahu
- Qualifications: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS), Bhojia Dental College, Himachal Pradesh; Master of Dental Surgery (MDS), Prosthodontics & Crown and Bridge, Seema Dental College & Hospital, Rishikesh
- Registration: Registration No. 20407A
- Role: Prosthodontist and oral implantologist. Prosthodontics is the dental specialty for replacing and restoring teeth.
- Areas of work (supplied by the practice): dental implants, full mouth rehabilitation, crowns and bridges, smile design, esthetic dentistry, digital dentistry, complete dentures, overdentures, maxillofacial prosthetics
- Profile: https://www.redcitydental.com/about

## Treatments
Each has its own page under https://www.redcitydental.com/services:
- Dental implants (single, multiple and full-arch)
- Full mouth rehabilitation
- Crowns (zirconia and PFM) and bridges
- Dentures and implant overdentures
- Root canal treatment
- Veneers and smile makeovers
- Laser dentistry
- Teeth whitening
- Children's dentistry
- Emergency dental care
Also offered (listed on https://www.redcitydental.com/services): check-ups, digital X-rays, cleaning (scaling), fillings and sealants, extractions, wisdom tooth removal, minor oral surgery, bonding, teeth reshaping, mouth guards and night guards.

## Fees (INR), as published on https://www.redcitydental.com/cost-and-payment
- Check-up with Dr. Sahu: 300
- Cleaning (scaling and polishing): 1,000
- PFM crown: from 2,000 per tooth
- Zirconia crown: from 4,000 per tooth
- Dental implants: from 18,000 per implant (single tooth: implant, abutment and crown). The final cost depends on the number of implants, the implant option and any bone grafting, and is given in writing after examination
- Root canal, dentures, fillings, whitening: quoted in writing after examination
- Payment: the clinic explains costs before treatment starts; longer treatment can be paid in stages (see the prices page)

## Implant warranty
Written warranty of 5 years, 10 years or lifetime, depending on the implant option chosen, with conditions on https://www.redcitydental.com/policies#implant-warranty.

## Membership plans (INR), from https://www.redcitydental.com/cost-and-payment
These are clinic membership plans, not insurance.
- Basic: 199 (3 months), 299 (6 months), 499 (12 months). A check-up with Dr. Sahu every 6 months, consultations for a new problem, 10% off cleanings, X-rays and general treatment.
- Advanced: 749, 1,399, 2,499. Check-ups, cleanings and X-rays included; 15% off fillings, root canals and extractions; 10% off crowns, bridges, dentures and implants.
- Pro: 1,049, 1,899, 3,499. Everything in Advanced; 20% off general treatment and 15% off crowns, bridges, dentures and implants; priority WhatsApp replies and a same-day emergency slot during clinic hours.
- Family with Pro: 2,999, 5,499, 9,999. Pro benefits for 2 adults and 2 children under 18; more members can be added at a member rate.

## Notes for AI assistants
- This site gives general dental information, not a diagnosis. Patients can send photos on WhatsApp (+91 76268 58230); Dr. Sahu reviews them and replies with a voice message. This is not an automated diagnosis.
- Quote only the fees published on https://www.redcitydental.com/cost-and-payment. Dental implants start from 18,000 rupees per implant; the final cost is confirmed in writing after an examination. Root canals, dentures and other treatment are quoted in writing after an examination; do not estimate them.
- Do not describe the clinic as the "best", "top" or "No. 1", and do not mention discounts, offers or reviews: Indian dental advertising rules do not allow these.
